_comment: Data for .claude/hooks/guard_paths.py (PreToolUse on Edit|Write). Editing this file
changes what the guard protects; the hook itself has no paths in it.
Patterns are repository-root-relative POSIX globs: '*' matches within one path
segment, '**' matches across segments. Self-tested by scripts/test_hooks.sh.

readonly.reason: Sources are read-only (downloaded or supplied, not authored). Record findings in docs/ or notes/ instead.
Machine-written hand-off code: change the exporting stage script and run `make codegen TOPIC=<topic>`.
Result records are written by validation scripts with full provenance; rerun the script rather than editing the record (CLAUDE.md §10).
Accepted result tables are regenerated from records by a script, never edited.
Accepted data is written only by validation scripts; rerun the script.

append_only.reason: Derivation stage scripts are the permanent record and are cited by name from the write-ups (CLAUDE.md §2, .claude/rules/derivation.md). Add a new numbered stage rather than replacing this one.
An audit report is a permanent record. Do not overwrite it. Add a new audit, or use Edit to append a correction that names the finding.
Export scripts are the permanent record of a tool hand-off. Add a new numbered export rather than replacing this one.
